title: pluginassembly
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, managedidentityid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, organizationid, PackageId.

authtype.description: Specifies mode of authentication with web sources like WebApp

content.description: Bytes of the assembly, in Base64 format.

content_binary.description: Bytes of the assembly, in Base64 format.

createdon.description: Date and time when the plug-in assembly was created.

culture.description: Culture code for the plug-in assembly.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the form is introduced.

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

ishidden.description: Information that specifies whether this component should be hidden.

ismanaged.description: Information that specifies whether this component is managed.

isolationmode.description: Information about how the plugin assembly is to be isolated at execution time; None / Sandboxed.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the plug-in assembly was last modified.

path.description: File name of the plug-in assembly.

pluginassemblyid.description: Unique identifier of the plug-in assembly.

pluginassemblyidunique.description: Unique identifier of the plug-in assembly.

publickeytoken.description: Public key token of the assembly.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

sourcehash.description: Hash of the source of the assembly.

sourcetype.description: Location of the assembly, for example 0=database, 1=on-disk.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the plug-in assembly.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the pluginassembly.

_managedidentityid_value.description: Unique identifier for managedidentity associated with pluginassembly.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the plug-in assembly.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the pluginassembly.

_organizationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the organization with which the plug-in assembly is associated.

_packageid_value.description: Unique identifier for Plugin Package associated with Plug-in Assembly.
